scope: Bounded older-outfit gallery expansion and current CN/Global/Korean official notices; not a complete inventory of competitor galleries.
limits: Retained whole source frames and community watermarks; attribution is not a redistribution license.
Excluded cropped/dark community Penglai’s Peaks, Wind’s Far Shore and Forged in Fire screenshots and all avatars/unrelated asset sections.
Knowing Hearts community page challenge was not solved; no photos added from that failed collection.
New CN article URL is September 30 but displayed publication date is September 29.
EN October notice accidentally heads Vindicated Way as Penglai’s Peaks. Paragraph and KO source resolve the identity without creating a duplicate.
Launch 05:00 UTC+8 is explicit; discount-end sentence has no explicit timezone.
CN event page 37780_1315698 discusses an unnamed exchange hair accessory; no invented item record.
Existing forecasts, schedules, official names and regional facts on archive entries remain unchanged. Community photos do not establish official Global identity or release.
